title: Sourcing policy and asset licence policy
context: Common Studio is an open, public-domain music production studio in software, written new in Python with permissive dependencies and released under the Unlicense. This task is part of its first milestones: the licence-clean spine that every later gate depends on. The owner's private reference pipeline may be consulted for ideas only; no text, configuration value, arrangement source, skill or asset from it may be copied, and every name, format and value is authored new.
objective: Write the sourcing policy and the asset licence policy as a single plain Markdown document, policy/sourcing-and-asset-licence-policy.md, that the ingest gate and the asset manifests enforce.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-09: The document defines the three evidence records (composition, edition, lyrics), each with source, basis, checked_at and checker, and what counts as a basis for each (author death dates by jurisdiction, publication facts, edition provenance, lyric authorship).
AC-09: It lists source classes as allowed, verify-only or banned with the reason for each, and states that a banned source is refused even for a public-domain tune.

AC-09: It defines the asset manifest entry (source, licence, checked_at, checker) and the allowed licence set (public domain, CC0, permissive with commercial derivatives), says attribution-only assets carry their attribution in the certificate, and refuses non-commercial and no-derivatives assets, including for tests.
AC-09: It states the clean-room rule for the private reference pipeline: ideas may be consulted, nothing copied, and any dedication by its owner must be recorded before import.
The document is plain Markdown, released under CC0-1.0, and no text is copied from any private source.
